task.title: Unify owner-finalize dispatch eligibility and freshness validation

scope.owned_layer: The single owner-finalize (owned_finalize_dispatch) eligibility predicate is_non_default_repository_finalization_pending in .orchestrator/dispatch_policy.py, consumed by both the planner/runtime-reservation predicate evaluate_task_delivery_admission and by task_execution_dispatch_candidate in .orchestrator/supervisor.py (which backs the stale-event freshness recheck stale_dispatch_skip_message -> current_dispatch_event_key and worker-lease/assignment revalidation).
not_changing: The hermetic execution-admission predicate in .orchestrator/rewrite/dispatch_admission.py (evaluate_dispatch_intent) and .orchestrator/rewrite/task_machine.py (dispatch_reason) are unchanged; they never encoded the receipt requirement and are not where the two predicates disagreed.
review-ready, owned-ready, owned-in-progress, dependency, health, global/account/resource capacity, pending review-decision, and operator-hold fences are unchanged.

The canonical auto-integrator (scripts/git/auto_integrator.py) and integration_receipt module (.orchestrator/rewrite/integration_receipt.py) are unchanged; no second scheduler, queue, task store, projection, or status authority was added. The auto-integrator already evaluates every review_approved row regardless of repository (it never special-cased Pantheon) and already writes the canonical integration_receipt once a Pantheon PR is merged into dev.

.orchestrator/test_dispatch_policy.py is not in this task's declared artifact contract and the handoff admission gate hard-rejects any PR diff touching it; it is left untouched even though this fix changes observable dispatch_policy.py behavior -- see known_limitation below.

defect.summary: PR #5771 (rejected) unified the two disagreeing predicates onto the repository-scoped is_non_default_repository_finalization_pending as it stood, which unconditionally exempted every Pantheon (default-repository) row from the receipt gate regardless of whether it had a live PR review_binding. That exemption is itself the underlying defect: acceptance 1 and the source SA_SD_PLAN.md require the canonical receipt gate to hold for the affected Pantheon path too, and the auto-integrator already treats a Pantheon PR delivery exactly like any other repository's -- it merges the PR and stamps integration_receipt before the row may be considered landed. Dispatching owner-finalize for a Pantheon review_approved row that still has an unmerged PR in flight (a live review_binding, no matching integration_receipt) races the auto-integrator's own merge.
defect.symptom: Hermetic reproduction: task_fixture(status=review_approved), target_repo=pantheon, generation=4, an exact review_binding (pr/head_sha/head_branch/base) but no integration_receipt. Before this fix, build_dispatch_plan emitted 1 owned_finalize_dispatch event and reserve_dispatch_plan appended it, because is_non_default_repository_finalization_pending returned False as soon as it saw target_repo == "pantheon", independent of whether a receipt-worthy PR delivery was in flight. The original (pre-PR-#5771) freshness predicate (task_has_current_canonical_integration_receipt, unconditional) correctly rejected this exact row; PR #5771 made the freshness recheck agree with the (wrong) planner behavior instead of the reverse.
defect.fix: is_non_default_repository_finalization_pending (.orchestrator/dispatch_policy.py) no longer branches on repository identity to decide whether a receipt is required. It now branches on whether the row carries a live review_binding: a row with no review_binding at all (a non-PR closeout) is never receipt-gated, exactly as before; a row with a review_binding -- Pantheon included -- must carry a matching current integration_receipt or owned_finalize_dispatch stays ineligible. Repository-scope validation (multi_repo_registry.validate_task_repository_scope) is still evaluated unconditionally and still fails closed (pending=True) for an unknown/misconfigured repository. Because task_execution_dispatch_candidate (supervisor.py) already called this exact shared function, planner, runtime reservation (reserve_dispatch_plan), and the stale-event freshness recheck now all agree for the Pantheon path without any further supervisor.py change.

behavioral_proof.pantheon_reproduction_and_fix: test_pantheon_pr_delivery_waits_for_exact_integration_receipt (.orchestrator/test_supervisor.py) is the actual Pantheon mismatch regression: task_fixture(status=review_approved), target_repo=pantheon, generation=4, an exact review_binding, no integration_receipt. It proves, through the real dispatch path (not just the pure predicate): (1) planner_decision and task_execution_dispatch_candidate agree the row is ineligible; (2) build_dispatch_plan emits zero events and reserve_dispatch_plan reserves nothing, leaving queue_events empty; (3) once the exact matching integration_receipt lands, planner_decision and task_execution_dispatch_candidate agree on OWNED_FINALIZE, build_dispatch_plan emits exactly one event, stale_dispatch_skip_message/current_dispatch_event_key confirm that event is not stale, and reserve_dispatch_plan reserves it (exactly one queued event); (4) a second reserve_dispatch_plan call against the same already-reserved plan is suppressed (duplicate reservation returns False, queue still holds exactly one event).
behavioral_proof.non_default_repository_unaffected: test_review_approved_waits_for_exact_integration_receipt and test_planner_and_freshness_agree_across_integration_receipt_states (execute-plans deliveries) are unchanged and still pass: the receipt-required behavior for non-default repositories, which already worked correctly, is untouched.
behavioral_proof.no_review_binding_pantheon_unaffected: test_planner_ops_fe_review_proof_unreceipted_does_not_starve_auto_integrator step 5 (a Pantheon task with no review_binding at all) is unchanged and still passes eligible/OWNED_FINALIZE: a non-PR Pantheon closeout is never receipt-gated.
behavioral_proof.worker_recovery_fixture_correction: test_approved_closeout_recovery_preserves_exact_reviewer_binding (.orchestrator/test_supervisor.py) modeled a Pantheon task with a live review_binding but no receipt and asserted the recovered task's replacement plan still contains 1 owned_finalize_dispatch event; that assumption depended on the exact defect this task repairs. The fixture now carries a matching integration_receipt (task_generation=1, valid across the post-recovery generation bump to 2, per integration_receipt's generation-fence contract), so the test continues to prove worker-lease recovery preserves the exact reviewer binding without relying on the fixed bug.

known_limitation.statement: test_evaluate_task_delivery_admission_multirepo_gate step 3 in .orchestrator/test_dispatch_policy.py (pre-existing, from OPS-INTEGRATION-FINALIZE-MULTIREPO-GATE-REGRESSION-001, not part of this task's declared artifacts) asserts a Pantheon task with a live review_binding and no integration_receipt is admitted. That assertion encodes the exact exemption this task removes, so it now fails locally: `.venv-pantheon/bin/python3 -m pytest -q .orchestrator/test_dispatch_policy.py` -> 1 failed, 73 passed.
known_limitation.why_not_fixed_here: .orchestrator/test_dispatch_policy.py is outside this task's artifact contract (artifacts: dispatch_policy.py, supervisor.py, test_supervisor.py, rewrite/dispatch_admission.py, rewrite/test_dispatch_admission.py, evidence.json). The handoff admission gate (.orchestrator/rewrite/task_contract.py:validate_task_artifact_diff_scope) hard-rejects any PR diff touching a file outside the declared contract, and widening that contract requires a Human/Ops-only, pre-dispatch-only artifact-contract command this owner cannot invoke while the task is in_progress.
known_limitation.ci_impact: None of the required branch-ci.yml gates (tooling smoke, tooling integration-authority, product/mixed smoke) execute .orchestrator/test_dispatch_policy.py, so this stale assertion does not block the required status checks on this PR.
known_limitation.recommended_follow_up: A Human/Ops-authorized follow-up task (artifact contract including .orchestrator/test_dispatch_policy.py) should correct that step 3 fixture the same way test_approved_closeout_recovery_preserves_exact_reviewer_binding was corrected here: attach a matching integration_receipt for the receipted case and assert task_not_dispatchable for the unreceipted case.
